hard_prerequisite: PERF-VMABI (VmExecState / HelperDescriptor / exception-interrupt / GC slot abstraction)
spec_basis: docs/roadmap.md §2 (G1-JIT minimum scope + required report + break-even decision quantity)
docs/engine-evolution-plan.md §八 (linear baseline compiler; JitMeta/JitCodeBlock; W^X obligations)
required_report: steady-state speedup on covered fixed-work loops
bailout cost (guard fail -> slow helper -> compiled continuation)
code retirement path (eviction / function destruction invalidation)
RW->RX transition + icache flush cost and mechanism

primary_metric.pass_condition: break_even_count falls inside the hotness range of real workloads
primary_metric.operationalization: >= 30% of dynamically executed bytecode on the bench_v8 v9 suite (opcode-profiling build measurement) belongs to functions whose observed hotness >= 2x break_even_count
primary_metric.basis: decision quantity and pass wording: doc; the 30%/2x operationalization: proposed

secondary_metrics.steady_state_speedup_min: +25% on the covered numeric-loop fixed-work microbench (context: all interpreter skeletons sit on the ~20.7 cyc/iter indirect-jump dispatch floor; a JIT that cannot beat the floor it removes has no thesis)
secondary_metrics.code_size_cap: report code bytes/bytecode byte; v0 macro-expansion cap 12x — above it, the RC inc/dec expansion strategy must be redesigned before eligibility

maximum_regression.jit_off_default_path: geomean <= 1.005 with the JIT compiled in but disabled (the interpreter must not pay for the spike's existence)

correctness_gates: zig build test, zig build smoke with JIT on for covered opcodes
test262 subset for covered opcode semantics, JIT on
exception propagation via explicit status return (no system unwind) demonstrated across a JIT frame
GC safepoint: collection triggered inside JIT code sees all live slots (shadow/audit instrumentation)
sample_protocol: measurement contract (sha256 020f2f18...); >=8 paired ABBA samples, pinned big core, CV <= 5%; insn+cycles same run

verdicts.pass: primary pass_condition + secondary metrics + correctness green -> G1-JIT=eligible; BACKEND-ORDER then prices it against G1-AOT
verdicts.redesign: a positive per-iter delta exists but break-even lands outside real hotness (compile cost dominated), or W^X/retirement obligations unresolved on a target platform -> respec compile-cost or platform strategy before re-ruling
verdicts.fail: jit_cost_per_iter >= interpreter_cost_per_iter on covered loops (no break-even exists), or the code-size/regression caps cannot be met -> G1-JIT=later
